observed_contracts: Separate thread_id and replied_message_id; optional is_thread_root and forwarded_message_id on the authored SendMessageRequest and nullable client envelope
GET messages/{root}/thread returns root, replies with message/depth, and X-Total
POST messages/redirect accepts message_ids, caps distinct messages at100, requires one plaintext source room, source membership and destination send permission
Service serializes durable single-message v1 and history-segment v2 redirect metadata with sender attribution
owned_choices: Every live-reference hydration checks current source readability, including nested references and thread projections; inaccessible source identifier/content is masked
Thread roots cannot be replies or thread children; replies stay in the root room/thread; ancestry depth capped32 and each page bounded without descendant expansion
Explicit text copies survive original deletion/revocation and are readable by the destination audience; only canonical minimal attribution, identifiers, text and timestamps copied
Attached, embedded, encrypted and nested-reference redirect sources rejected; existing private file owner/public authority unchanged
Immutable canonical receipt distinguishes genuine snapshots; reserved caller meta.redirect and absent-receipt historical metadata cannot forge copies
Optional128-character idempotency header binds source-ID set and source/destination membership incarnations; duplicate input IDs rejected
Bound canonical authority proof precedes source existence discovery; owned detail/list/sync root counts match the same-room plaintext/live-sender thread boundary
registration: separate additive before/after delta; no workflow/group changes
